newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Resolute finds more gold in Ghana.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Resolute finds more gold in Ghana.

text.p: Gold miner Resolute Samantha Ltd said on Thursday it had recorded further significant results from drilling at its Obotan gold project in Ghana.

"The recent deep drilling results, which include 14 metres at 16.24 grams per tonne (g/t) gold and 14 metres at 5.76 g/t, together with results released at the end of October including 20 metres at 13.76 g/t (and 32 metres at 3.3 g/t demonstrate the strong potential to define additional reserves below the current open pit design," the company said.
Resolute has a 82.5 percent stake in the project, which is located 40 km north west of the Ashanti mine in Ghana. The remaining 7.5 percent is owned by Obotan Minerals Co Ltd.

Resolute said the grade and width of the mineralisation also indicated the underground potential of the system. The Obotan project is under construction with first gold production at a rate 126,000 ounces a year expected in June next year.

Resolute said the mine schedule has ore being sourced concurrently from the two of the three deposits discovered so far. "Drilling results indicate that all three deposits remain open at depth and along strike," Resolute said.
Resolute shares closed eight cents higher at A$2.76.
